description: LLM-powered rich sentiment analysis: polarity + Plutchik 8-emotion vector + named entities + aspect-based per-entity sentiment. ETL stages for batch enrichment, REST API for chart-ready queries and agent integration.

stages.description: Runs LLM on a text field. Enriches the row with polarity, label, confidence, language, plus JSON fields: emotions (Plutchik-8), entities (NER), aspects (per-entity polarity). Does NOT persist — pipe to sentiment_save.

arg_schema.name: text_field
arg_schema.description: Field containing the text to analyze

arg_schema.name: max_chars
arg_schema.description: Truncate input to this length before sending to LLM

stages.description: Atomic sink: persists an enriched row to sentiment_documents + sentiment_emotions + sentiment_entities + sentiment_aspects in a single transaction. Deduplicates by (org_id, text_hash, source_type).

Denormalizes sentiment_aspects_json into ONE row per (document × aspect). Companion of sentiment_save: place AFTER save so DB persistence sees the intact document, while downstream save_csv / save_parquet sees the exploded flat shape. Trino / dashboards query the flat output without UNNEST / json_extract.

arg_schema.name: aspects_field
arg_schema.description: Row field carrying the aspects JSON array

arg_schema.name: keep_empty
arg_schema.description: If true, rows with zero aspects emit one row with NULL aspect_* columns instead of being dropped

arg_schema.name: entities_field
arg_schema.description: Row field carrying the entities JSON array (used to enrich each emitted row with aspect_entity_type via text-match)

stages.description: Filters rows by sentiment_label, polarity range, dominant emotion, or presence of an entity.

arg_schema.name: dominant_emotion
arg_schema.description: Keep rows where this emotion has the highest score

arg_schema.name: contains_entity
arg_schema.description: Keep rows where entities[] contains this text (case-insensitive)

stages.description: Source: loads documents from DB filtered by org / source_type / time window. Joins emotions/entities/aspects on demand.

arg_schema.name: from_date
arg_schema.description: ISO date inclusive lower bound on published_at

arg_schema.name: to_date
arg_schema.description: ISO date exclusive upper bound on published_at

stages.description: Refreshes the materialized aggregate tables (daily_overall, daily_by_entity, daily_emotions). Run on a schedule. Operates on its current org only.

arg_schema.name: lookback_days
arg_schema.description: Recompute aggregates for the last N days
